name: 目的から選ぶ呼吸の一覧
prompt:
Create attempt 2 for the same static Japanese Lighthouse component LH13-0028. Keep the authored mock’s exact content and improve its alignment. Output a crisp raster at the 390:455 aspect ratio.

REFERENCE ORDER
Image 1 is the exact assigned Finch crop. Preserve the four original illustrations, their order, shapes, and purple artwork.
Image 2 is the authoritative 390x455 Japanese mock for all copy, component layout, white canvas/cards, and omitted controls. The user’s direct correction at 2026-10-20T14:08:21.242Z asks for purple instead of the green tint on the selected 朝 tab. Use soft lavender purple there with a readable purple label; no green tint or gradient.

MATCH THESE MOCK COORDINATES
Canvas: exactly 390x455. Use a perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF background and card surfaces; no grain, noise, diagonal tonal texture, shading, or surface gradient. No drop shadows.
Heading: visible glyphs begin at x24,y12; left aligned; frame about 342x28. Use 「呼吸でひと息」 in Meiryo Bold 20px/28px, with about 18px visible glyph height. Do not enlarge it or use display-title scale.
Tabs: y60, 70x36 each at x12,88,164,240,316. Labels exactly 「朝」「元気に」「集中」「穏やかに」「夜」. Only 朝 is selected, with the same soft purple selection and contrasting purple text; other labels stay quiet on white.
Cards: x18, width354, height76, at y112,196,280,364. Each card has a thin quiet neutral outline and white fill. Do not widen beyond x372 or reduce the 18px side margins.
Each icon image: x30 inside the 390px canvas, 50x50, vertically centered in its card. Preserve the original illustration instead of redesigning it.
Each card title begins at x96; description begins at x96. Use the right-side plain value 「10」. Do not add overflow dots, a plus, or lightning.

EXACT CONTENT
1. 「落ち着いた呼吸」 — 「静かにひと息つきたいときに。」 — 「10」
2. 「気分を切り替える呼吸」 — 「新しいことを始める前に。」 — 「10」
3. 「気持ちを整える呼吸」 — 「いまの自分に意識を向ける。」 — 「10」
4. 「朝の呼吸」 — 「一日の始まりに、ひと呼吸。」 — 「10」

Typography: established Meiryo-like Japanese sans-serif. Heading Bold 20/28, card titles Bold 14/24, tabs/descriptions/values Regular 12/16, tracking 0. Keep all glyphs exact and unclipped.

Retain a quiet white component with the source’s purple illustrations and the user-requested purple selected tab. No green selected tint, purple full-screen background, English text, medical or physiological claims, added actions, extra metrics, shadows that dominate, other gradients, watermark, or device frame. This is a still image, with no motion.
reviewNotes: Purple selected 朝 tab follows user direction. Needs correction for card margins, heading and type scale, faint white-surface texture, and reconstructed illustrations.
